visualCharacteristics: Grid of promotional image tiles with a full-bleed background photo, overlay label text at the bottom-left, and a green circular arrow button. Single column on mobile, three across on desktop with mixed tile sizes.
contentPattern: One row per promo tile. Each row: cell 1 = background image, cell 2 = overlay label + optional CTA link.
usage: Promotional tile grid, e.g. 'Plan your next trip'.
